query: What is Aurora's mission for delivering self-driving technology?

gold_claims.text: Aurora's mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

reference_answer: Aurora states that its mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

query: What real-world AI products does Tesla identify as central to its business strategy?

gold_claims.text: Tesla identifies FSD (Supervised), Robotaxi, and Optimus as its real-world AI products.

reference_answer: Tesla identifies Full Self-Driving (Supervised), Robotaxi, and Optimus among the products it uses to bring AI into the real world.
must_not_claim: Tesla identifies a fully autonomous consumer vehicle as already deployed.

query: How does Mobileye define its fiscal year?

gold_claims.text: Mobileye uses a 52- or 53-week fiscal year ending on the last Saturday in December.

reference_answer: Mobileye uses a 52- or 53-week fiscal year that ends on the last Saturday in December.
must_not_claim: Mobileye's fiscal year ends on December 31 every year.

query: Since what year does Alphabet say Google has operated as an AI-first company?

gold_claims.text: Alphabet says Google has been an AI-first company since 2016.

reference_answer: Alphabet says Google has operated as an AI-first company since 2016.

query: What products and software-enabled services does General Motors say it provides worldwide?

gold_claims.text: GM says it designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts, and provides software-enabled services and subscriptions worldwide.

reference_answer: GM says it designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts, while providing software-enabled services and subscriptions worldwide.

query: When was Ford Motor Company incorporated in Delaware, and where is it headquartered?

gold_claims.text: Ford was incorporated in Delaware in 1919 and is based in Dearborn, Michigan.

reference_answer: Ford says it was incorporated in Delaware in 1919 and is based in Dearborn, Michigan.
must_not_claim: Ford is headquartered in Detroit, Michigan.

query: What workloads does NVIDIA say its accelerated computing platform addresses?

gold_claims.text: NVIDIA lists AI model training and inference, data analytics, scientific computing, robotics, and 3D graphics among accelerated-computing workloads.

reference_answer: NVIDIA lists AI training and inference, data analytics, scientific computing, robotics, and 3D graphics among the computationally intensive workloads its platform addresses.
must_not_claim: NVIDIA says its platform is limited to graphics workloads.

query: When was Qualcomm incorporated in California and reincorporated in Delaware?

gold_claims.text: Qualcomm was incorporated in California in 1985 and reincorporated in Delaware in 1991.

reference_answer: Qualcomm says it incorporated in California in 1985 and reincorporated in Delaware in 1991.
must_not_claim: Qualcomm was incorporated in Delaware in 1985.

query: What separation of Aptiv's Electrical Distribution Systems business did the company announce?

gold_claims.text: Aptiv announced a planned tax-free spin-off of its Electrical Distribution Systems business into a new independent public company named Versigent.

reference_answer: Aptiv announced plans to separate its Electrical Distribution Systems business through a planned tax-free spin-off into an independent public company, Versigent.
must_not_claim: Aptiv announced a sale of its entire company.

query: How does Ouster describe its role in sensing and perception for Physical AI?

gold_claims.text: Ouster describes a unified sensing and perception platform combining digital lidar, cameras, AI compute, sensor fusion, perception software, and AI models.

reference_answer: Ouster describes itself as providing a unified Physical AI sensing and perception platform that combines digital lidar, cameras, AI compute, sensor fusion, perception software, and AI models.
must_not_claim: Ouster provides lidar hardware without software or perception capabilities.

query: Which consumer vehicles does Rivian describe on its R1 platform?

gold_claims.text: Rivian's R1 platform consists of the R1T two-row five-passenger pickup truck and R1S three-row seven-passenger SUV.

reference_answer: Rivian describes the R1T, a two-row five-passenger pickup truck, and the R1S, a three-row seven-passenger SUV, as the two vehicles on its R1 platform.
must_not_claim: The R1 platform consists of the R2 and R3.
